Saw Cutting Services for Metal
Saw Cutting for Specialty Metals

When it comes to cutting specialty metals, precision and efficiency are paramount. At Titanium Industries, we take pride in offering top-notch Saw Cutting Services that meet the diverse needs of our customers. Whether you require titanium round, rectangle, hex, or hollow bar, titanium billet, titanium plate, titanium block, or custom-sized products, we have you covered. Our commitment to customer satisfaction and quality service is evident in our extensive range of cutting capabilities.
State-of-the-Art Plate Saws for Unparalleled Precision

Our state-of-the-art plate saws are equipped with cutting-edge technology to handle products up to 17″ high and 155″ long. With such advanced machinery, we ensure that every cut is made with unparalleled precision, guaranteeing that your specialty metal products are crafted to perfection. Whether you need bars, plates, pipes, or blocks cut, our skilled technicians can meet your requirements with unmatched expertise.
Versatile Band Saw Cutting for Any Specialty Metal

At Titanium Industries, we also employ band saws that can handle any round, rectangular, or square specialty metal product stocked in our inventory. Our extensive bar saw and plate saw capacity allows us to handle cutting projects of various complexities with ease. No matter the size or shape of your specialty metal, our band saw cutting services deliver exceptional results.
Efficiency and Flexibility for Your Cutting Needs

With multiple pieces of cutting equipment at each of our facilities, we’re uniquely capable of providing quick turnaround on cut parts, regardless of the volume. Whether you require a few custom-sized pieces or large-scale production, we have the resources to accommodate your needs efficiently. Rest assured, our dedicated team will ensure that your orders are processed promptly and delivered on time.
Precision Cut-to-Size Solutions

Our Saw Cutting Services offer precision cut-to-size solutions that save you valuable time and money. By providing exact dimensions as per your specifications, we eliminate the need for additional processing, streamlining your production process and reducing costs. Our cutting-edge technology and expertise allow us to achieve tight tolerances upon request, ensuring that your products meet the highest standards.
No Minimum Order Quantities – Your Satisfaction, Our Priority

At Titanium Industries, customer satisfaction is our top priority. We understand that every project is unique, and we are committed to providing unmatched flexibility. Our Saw Cutting Services come with no minimum order quantities, giving you the freedom to order exactly what you need, when you need it.
Experience the Excellence of Saw Cutting Services

With over 50 years of experience as a trusted specialty metal supplier, Titanium Industries has established itself as a leader in the industry. Our team of experts is passionate about delivering top-tier solutions and is well-versed in the latest cutting technologies. When you choose us for your Saw Cutting needs, you can rest assured that you are receiving the best service and quality products.

Unlock the full potential of your specialty metal products with Titanium Industries’ cutting-edge services. Contact us today to discuss your project requirements and explore how our Saw Cutting Services can elevate your next endeavor.
Advantages of Band Saw Cutting
Extensive bar saw and plate saw capacity around the world
Cutting bars, plate, pipe, and block up to 17″ thick and 155″ long
Cut-to-size saves both time and money
Quick response on cut to size parts regardless of volume
Tight tolerances available upon request
No minimum order quantities
